provenance.note: Derived from an offline audit. Not a codec implementation, full roundtrip proof, or GPU benchmark.

audited_palette.layout: 16-byte tensor header; uint64 offsets plus sentinel; each tile raw or [uint8 palette_length, palette bytes, bit-packed indices]. Whole-tensor raw fallback; existing tensor directory reused.
audited_palette.excludes: GPU alignment, kernel layout changes, GPU scratch and integration metadata. No encoded checkpoint is written. No inference kernels are tested.

proposed_binary_exceptions.assumptions: 1 bit/entry, uint32 prefix offsets into 2-byte exception records per 256 entries, end sentinel per tensor, hypothetical 16-byte header/tensor; excludes outer manifest, GPU alignment, scratch and execution-layout changes.
